title: Bay 2 Reagent Spill Report

sections.heading: 2. Description
sections.body: A reagent spill on the Bay 2 analyzer halted processing over a one hour window. See Figure 2 for the tray layout.

sections.heading: 3. Timeline
sections.body: Reagent-level warning at 08:12; spill detected 08:20; resumed after decontamination at 11:20.

sections.heading: 4. Contributing Factors
sections.body: Control-software 7.2.0 was running on the affected analyzer. A secondary catch tray was absent.
